comment_for_reviewers: Generalist edge-case fixture. The shadow refs resolve to empty strings — the renderer suppresses the shadow block when name resolves empty. Traits use signal-kind data; cohort bars are absent because within-archetype positioning is unavailable for Generalist (by design).
tagline: No single signature — your practice flexes between modes.

shadow.tagline: Your practice doesn't have one fixed shadow. The flex is the shape.

section_identity.heading: Your *fingerprint* — by its absence
section_identity.lede: No single archetype dominates. That's the read.

traits.characterization: Numbered, stepped-out plans before the agent moves — when the task calls for it.
You bring observed behavior, error logs, real outputs into the conversation.
When the agent finishes, sometimes you don't just read — you run.

pullquote.text: You're not committing to one mode. The across-session view is your practice.

recognition_lines: Your last three sessions don't look like each other — and that's deliberate.
You can name which archetype each session was, in retrospect.
Asked which mode you're in, you say it depends — and you mean it.

section_outcome.heading: The *outcome* signal
section_outcome.lede: Different modes ship at different rates. Which mode you reached for matters more than your overall average.
section_outcome.headline: You ship — but the across-session distribution tells more than this number.
section_outcome.body: Without one dominant archetype, the per-mode question is the better one: when you reached for the Manager mode, did the careful setup pay off? When you reached for Streamliner, did clean-and-quick land?

section_moves.heading: Two *moves* to try this month
section_moves.lede: Pick a borrow — let it tilt your sessions for a week.

moves.body_lead: Reality Testers ship at the highest rate of any archetype, and the borrow generalizes across whichever mode you're in.
moves.body_action: Pick three of next week's sessions. Before you accept the agent's output, pull up `git diff` and read it line by line. Notice the spots where you'd ask a follow-up — that's the move.
moves.effect_size_note: verification arc correlates with +13–17pp on shipping

moves.verb_phrase: Name the doc or RFC in your opening prompt.
moves.body_lead: Without a dominant default, you re-derive setup each session. Citing the convention up front is the Manager's anchor — it tilts the agent toward your team's shape from turn one.
moves.body_action: Pick one opener and use it for a week: cite the relevant doc, RFC, or style guide *by name* in your first prompt. Notice if the rest of the session shape stabilizes.

colophon.footnote: Generalist is a positive label, not a fallback. Re-run monthly to watch for motion.
